releases.notes:
Multi-loader release from the current 1.20–1.21 compatibility work.

This release contains 34 build-verified production JARs: 19 Fabric, 4 Forge, and 11 NeoForge targets. Each filename identifies its Minecraft version and loader. See `MULTIVERSION.md` for the full matrix and remaining compatibility gaps.

Minecraft 1.18.2, 1.16.5, and 1.12.2 are not included in this release.
